requirements.title: User Login Authentication
requirements.businessValue: Allow registered users to securely authenticate using username and password to protect restricted application routes.
requirements.userJourney: User navigates to application -> redirected to `/login` if unauthenticated -> enters credentials -> clicks login -> redirected to `/home`.

acceptanceCriteria.then: authenticate the user, save user state in localStorage, and navigate to `/home`.

requirements.title: Shopping App Home Page
requirements.businessValue: Provide users with a simple shopping homepage to discover products and start shopping.
requirements.userJourney: User logs in -> redirected to `/home` -> views products/categories -> selects a product or category.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the shopping homepage should be displayed.
categories, search bar, and featured products should be visible.

acceptanceCriteria.when: the user clicks Add to Cart
acceptanceCriteria.then: the product should be added to the cart and the cart count should update.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user enters a product name in the search bar

acceptanceCriteria.then: products belonging to that category should be displayed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user clicks the cart icon
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user should be navigated to the cart page.
the user should be redirected to `/login`.
